atomic_units: Memory Title, Description, and Content fields parsed deterministically; no manual sentence selection.
embedding: exact cached all-MiniLM-L6-v2 mean-pooling + L2 normalization used by the released retrieval audit

continuous_metrics.opposite_branch_explainability: for each field unit, maximum cosine to any field unit in the opposite reward branch
continuous_metrics.target_residual_applicability: maximum over branch field units of residual_weight * max(0, cosine(unit,target_intent))
continuous_metrics.neutral_alignment: Shopping only: semantic alignment of outcome-blind neutral field units to the S/F pair

threshold_policy: No threshold is selected and no binary gate is tuned in D0. Report full continuous distributions and per-source/per-target values.
decision_authority: D0 may falsify obvious representation feasibility but cannot authorize provider execution or expand claims. A fresh collision review and separate Problem/Economy contract are required before any method run.
